jobs.title: Program Manager, Strategic Project Development  (Hybrid Schedule)
jobs.location: Westwood, MA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Eversource will not offer immigration-related sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B, O-1, J-1, TN, E-3, etc.).  Applicants requiring visa sponsorship to start employment with Eversource will not be considered.

Our Team:

Eversource is hiring a Program Manager, Strategic Project Development, Transmission located out of the Westwood, MA office.

The Program Manager, Strategic Project Development, contributes to the advancement of Major and Strategic Projects within the Company’s Massachusetts Electric Sector Modernization Plan (ESMP) throughout Transmission by implementing cross-functional leadership throughout the Company and executing on the Capital Plan while adhering to core business synergies.

The role will include the implementation of comprehensive strategies for advancing early-stage development for a portfolio of strategic transmission and substation projects, including internal organization and analytics, and support for external stakeholder relationship building in collaboration with other teams to support the Company’s role as the leading provider of Transmission.

The Program Manager role will be expected to work collaboratively and coordinate with all relevant departments within the Company including System Planning, Engineering, Siting, Real Estate, Engagement and Equity, Regulatory, Procurement, Legal, Scheduling, and later-stage Project Management. This role reports to the Manager of Strategic Project Development and will also work closely with the Director of Strategic Project Development to ensure alignment and cooperative communication across Strategic Project execution.

Essential Functions:
- Responsible for all aspects of a portfolio of strategic ESMP transmission and substation projects from early-stage development to hand off to Project Management Organization (prior to traditional project lifecycle)

- Oversee a cross-functional project team including, System Planning, Engineering, Siting, Real Estate, Legal, Project Management, Engagement, Regulatory Affairs, Environmental Affairs, and other internal stakeholders to establish and organize ongoing development plan

- Ensures that all strategic solutions are vetted in a manner consistent with the Company’s safety and procurement policies and programs

- Works with the appropriate departments to develop schedules and budget of ESMP strategic projects in early-stage development and is responsible for the implementation, prior to execution

- Supports development and documentation of Company Policies related to development and execution of strategic transmission projects addressing items such as feasibility, planning, siting, permitting, construction, etc.

- Focus on both internal and external collaboration

- Maintains familiarity with current and upcoming Policies and Programs that could facilitate Transmission Development

- Works with the Manager/Director to develop metrics by which to evaluate the success of transmission projects and continues to track project-level and ESMP program progress; and collaborates with other Program Managers and Senior Program Managers within Strategic Project Development team when needed

- Facilitate discussions with key stakeholders to assure alignment and key information exchange to advance Strategic Transmission Projects

- Assists with representing Eversource Transmission on committees, groups, associations, or other efforts consistent with Strategic Projects

- Assists with representing Eversource Transmission at public meetings, regulatory hearings, town hall meetings, and any special meetings that may occur

- Ensures Manager and Director of Strategic Project Development are briefed regularly on the status of job responsibilities for the development of strategic projects and status of action items

Technical Knowledge/Skills
- Project management experience required

- Ability to develop and present reports within the organization

- Strong computer and analytical skills

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment across multiple subject matters, such as permitting, engineering, real estate, interconnection, finance, community engagement

- Understanding of onshore development of electric infrastructure projects, such as solar or wind

- Ability to take in multidisciplinary pieces of early-stage project development and make decisions in a timely manner

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences internally and externally

- Demonstrated interest in ongoing learning and process improvement

- Interest in progressing the State’s electrification efforts in advancement of Massachusetts’ clean energy and climate goals

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in a technical (i.e., engineering, environmental, communication, renewable energy ), business discipline, related degree or equivalent experience will be considered

- Masters, law, or other advanced qualifications desirable

Experience:
- Minimum of five (5) years of related experience

- Experience developing competitive infrastructure projects and knowledge of electric transmission and distribution systems preferred

Licenses & Certifications:
- Valid Driver’s license is required

Working Conditions:
- Must be available to work emergency restoration assignment as required

- HYBRID SCHEDULE

Eversource supports work-life balance by offering hybrid schedules for certain roles. Eligibility is based on job responsibilities, operational needs, nature of work and team dynamics. Current guidelines require employees to work at least three days in the office, including Tuesdays and Wednesdays, with the third day set by the employee and supervisor based on department needs. These guidelines apply to roles approved for remote work and are subject to change, based on managerial discretion and work performance. All applicants must be able to work five days in the office if needed (for example: emergencies, training, or other business needs) or should the policy change.

In this role you are responsible for developing, monitoring, and reporting on financial and schedule project controls metrics for the regional department in Massachusetts. - Coordinate between project management and eBuilder on formal project records and project assignment requests.
- Identify department level training needs and then develop and/or facilitate training with SMEs.
- Provide financial management training and mentorship to new employees to ensure consistency with department practices and Eversource procedures.
- Meet regularly with management to discuss financial action items, current department forecast in comparison with budget, key variances and reasons, action items for future forecasting.

Technical Knowledge/Skill/Education/Licenses/Certifications:
- Excellent technical, quantitative, and analytical skills.
- Ability to develop and present reports within the organization.
- Strong oral and written communication skills.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to make decisions in a timely manner.
- Familiarity with the utility industry is required, work experience at an ISO/RTO a plus.
- MS Office proficiency and MS Excel expertise required, coding and visualization experience preferred, GIS software experience a plus.
- Demonstrates strong analytical skills, ability to apply knowledge to solve problems, strong team building skills, and interest in managing and developing talent.
- General understanding of FERC and / or New England state energy regulation desirable.
- Valid Motor Vehicle Operator’s License is required.

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Finance, Business, Statistics, Math, or related experience

Experience:
- Minimum of four (4) to six (6) years of related experience

- Must be available to work emergency restoration assignment as required.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Process Improvement (Hybrid Schedule)
jobs.location: Hartford, CT, United States of America
jobs.description:
Eversource will not offer immigration-related sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B, O-1, J-1, TN, E-3, etc.).  Applicants requiring visa sponsorship to start employment with Eversource will not be considered.
In this role, you will be responsible for evaluating, designing, and managing process improvement initiatives to enhance the performance of Eversource resources. You will independently lead assigned process improvement and business process initiatives by defining scope, developing project plans, engaging key stakeholders and subject matter experts, and driving initiatives through completion with minimal oversight. In addition, you will analyze and measure the effectiveness of existing business processes and develop sustainable, repeatable, and quantifiable business process improvements, while collecting and analyzing process data to initiate, develop and recommend business practices and procedures that focus on enhanced safety, increased productivity, and reduced costs. This is a highly collaborative role where you will work closely with internal resources to assess critical business processes, tools, and resources to identify and prioritize process improvement. Essential Functions
- Documents business processes using BPMN 2.0 standards within SAP Signavio Process Modeling by interviewing and collaborating with subject matter experts to elicit process information and develop accurate current-state and future-state process models.
- Leads cross-functional teams on complex process improvement engagements, including structured process analysis and future-state design workshops.
- Works collaboratively with teams to identify and implement enhancements to existing policies, procedures, instructions, systems, etc. that improve operational discipline.
- Analyzes and identifies current process gaps using observations, data collection, data analysis, current-state process analysis, process ideologies and communication with management and frontline staff.
- Measures the effectiveness of current-state processes, systems, etc. as well as benefits gained through implemented enhancements.
- Identifies issues, root causes, strategies for improvement and development of implementation and sustainment plans.
- Develops a summary of findings, recommendations, and action plans for management to review and approve.
- Effectively applies various continuous improvement tools and operating discipline to drive assigned initiatives to positive outcomes.
- Independently manages assigned process improvement and business process initiatives with minimal oversight, including defining scope, developing project plans, coordinating resources, managing schedules, facilitating stakeholder engagement, and driving initiatives through implementation and measurement.
- Develops and maintains tools, applications, and systems critical to the process improvement initiatives.
- Develops tools and leverages technology to share relevant information with all stakeholders so business units can learn from process defects, reduce likelihood of future reoccurrence, and improve the mindset of personnel involved in the process.
- Develops action plans and processes, in coordination with key stakeholders and subject matter experts, for integrating activities and optimizing department resources to meet major goals and objectives.

Technical Knowledge/Skill

- Ability to influence without direct authority.
- Expertise and working knowledge of process improvement methods, internal controls implementation, change management leadership, and root cause analysis techniques.
- Self-motivated and goal oriented; demonstrated ability to independently scope, plan, organize, and drive process improvement initiatives with minimal supervision.
- Willingness to learn about and integrate new processes and technologies while, when applicable, breaking old paradigms and barriers.
- Strong process elicitation and interviewing skills, with the ability to gather, synthesize, and translate information from subject matter experts into structured business process documentation.
- Strong facilitation and communication skills (including written, oral, and public speaking) required, with demonstrated ability to develop structured workshop agendas and lead cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts through process analysis and future-state design.
- Demonstrated strong analytical and critical thinking skills, including the ability to analyze current-state processes, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and facilitate the development of future-state processes.
- Ability to effectively communicate and interact with stakeholders at all levels of authority.
- Demonstrated aptitude and curiosity for learning and implementing new tools and technology.
- Strong knowledge and experience in process mapping and documentation using BPMN 2.0 standards.
- Ability to consistently apply established business process modeling standards, conventions, and governance requirements.
- Extensive experience in process modeling and analysis; knowledge and hands-on experience in SAP Signavio Process Modeling preferred.

Education

A Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Experience

A minimum of eight (8) years of related experience in process improvement, business process management, or a related discipline, including experience leading complex process improvement initiatives, is required.

Working Conditions:

- Must be available to work emergency restoration assignment as required.
- Must be available to travel between MA/CT/NH as necessary.
